version: UST 1.0 conformance vectors (rc.66 - a root is published TWICE and only the SEAL enumerates: the batch commitment gets the prev-only `anchor` subtype, root REQUIRED and constituents ABSENT, because enumeration is not an input to the inclusion predicate and IS a membership oracle over other principals (#127, F.5u); prior rc.65: REGISTRY registers and MEASURES the verdict, completeness and forkChoice result vocabularies against actual code usage; the measurement found an error code in the RESULT slot and a second vocabulary under the same field name, #111; prior rc.40: external-audit remediation: 5 P0 fixed structurally (epic UST-1o6); prior rc.33: #75 ROOT 3 (math-derived, NO manifest): forkChoice/verifyStream resolve per-frame AUTHORITY (impersonation P0-03) + grid EQUALITY (off-grid P0-04); stream-authority/stream-grid/fork-choice vectors; prior: - #75 ROOT 1 two-phase verify + anchor-time (authority-at-time vectors: retired/compromised/premature K_n(t) window judged against the PROVEN anchor); prior: - #75 ROOT 2 key-log temporal state machine (keylog-state vectors: revoked/rotated-out/retired key cannot sign later; closed key_op schema); prior: - #75 strict encoders P1-01/02/03 (utf8-reject, b64url, cadence); prior: — self-audit fix: freshness:attested now requires a VERIFIED keylogHeadAnchor (inclusion + substrate-final), a raw self-computed head hash proves nothing = overclaim closed. Prior: #41 canon arbiter, #40 identity hardening, #44 agent-safety, #45 downgrade + fork-choice)
note: Deterministic + reproducible. Keypairs from fixed seeds (A=0011..eeff, B=ffee..1100). canon=JCS tightened; H(tag,x)=sha256(ascii(tag)||0x00||x); content_hash=H("ust:state",canon({ust,state})); key_id=H("ust:keylog",raw_pub); partition_hash=H("ust:shard",canon({domain_shard,ust_id,partition,value})) — UNIFORM, every partition binds domain_shard, name is a VALUE (non-colliding), no domain-less computed. Each vector states the SPEC rule it pins. Signature-type vectors use expect: 'VALID' | 'E-SIG' for the Ed25519 PRIMITIVE check (strict, canonical-S); this is not a document verdict — a conforming verifier's document verdict is always tier-qualified (VALID:LIGHT/HIGH/TOP), never a bare VALID. Partition names inside hash/commit inputs (e.g. 'secret') are arbitrary sample names, not protocol features.

rev94 — authority-BOUND requires strength ∈ {corroborated, authoritative} AND status = verified. A provably pre-compromise key (U < C ≤ R) is `suspect`: the assurance derivation NEUTRALIZES it to the floor, so an ANCHOR-INCLUDED candidate signed by it remains an imposter for the name and can never be canonical (§3.1 fork-choice, F.5c).

§11.3 at a moment at/after effective_from the change is in force

§11.3 the signature covers the grid — rewriting cadence without re-signing is refused
§11.3 an ordinary observation is not a key-context document — refused before the class check is reached
§11.3 only class:cadence moves the grid — a VALID key-log entry misplaced in the cadence log is E-MALFORMED

S13 based_on/constituents breadth per node <= 64 — a STRUCTURAL bound, raised by no declaration (F.9.5)
vectors.note: 65 constituents sealed FLAT. The escape is COMPOSITION, not capacity: ceil(N/64) nodes under one root. The specification's own worked example showed the flat form over 120 for four months (#101).

vectors.rule: S20.1/F.5o byte-agreement is decidable from bytes and says NOTHING about substrate: two locators on ONE provider satisfy it exactly as two vendors would
S20.1 a named copy that differs FAILS agreement; an agreeing sibling does not rescue it
S20.1 silence is not agreement — no declared copy is NOT ATTESTED, never a pass
F.5o/F.5a.1 independence is never self-declared: a caller-supplied independence coordinate is REFUSED, not ignored
S20/F.5p a DECLARED surface that does not answer is a promise not kept — FAIL, never a skip
S20/F.5p an UNDECLARED absent surface is NOT OFFERED — settled, not a transient
S20/F.5p a PRESENT surface is attested whether or not the profile names it — silence cannot hide evidence
F.5p a profile may ADD a copy and never RELOCATE a standard surface: resolution roots at the well-known location only
S20/F.5p a profile that DECLARES a companion copy owes it: the copy not answering is a promise not kept, not a missing option
S20.1/F.5o a companion a profile names is judged by BYTES: agreement is the whole property, and naming it earns nothing beyond the obligation
F.9.5-b depth(N)=ceil(log_64 N); the ENTIRE ust_id second-resolution space (3652060 days x 86400) seals at depth 7, strictly below D_MAX=8
F.5q-a darkness is not decidable from one substrate: one silent declared leg is PARTIAL, never dark
F.5q dark = nothing on ANY declared substrate — the universal claim over the declared set
F.5q/F.5p admissibility: the anchored row never consults the declaration — silence in the profile cannot hide evidence
F.5q-b a quantifier over an undeclared set is not a claim: no declaration yields unknown, never printing
